title: Coaching and Mentoring Skills for Managers
overview: Managers often face significant challenges related to people performance, regardless of their experience level. Success hinges on enhancing effectiveness through others. This course is designed for professionals looking to advance their supervisory and managerial skills through coaching and mentoring. It covers essential skills and qualifications needed to excel as a coach or mentor and explains how these processes effectively operate.
audience: Managers and supervisors who need to coach and mentor others to help them achieve and surpass their performance goals.
methodology: The course involves extensive role-playing to develop coaching and mentoring skills. Participants will also deliver mini-presentations to demonstrate their understanding of the course material.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Define and differentiate coaching, counseling, and mentoring
Understand the application, timing, and methodology of coaching in the workplace
Analyze and identify their own coaching styles and apply this insight effectively
Learn the skills, traits, and qualifications of an ideal coach
Enhance communication skills to improve coaching effectiveness
Apply various coaching strategies, tools, and techniques
Understand and implement mentoring practices and manage mentoring relationships
